name: Wacom Pro Pen 2 (KP504E)
summary: Wacom Pro Pen 2 (KP504E) - KP504E - Accessories & Spare Parts - Wacom Pro Pen 2 delivers Wacom’s most accurate and advanced pen performance and realistic pen-on-paper feel. Battery free EMR technology, 8,192 levels of pressure sensitivity, tilt-respon
description_html:
Wacom Pro Pen 2 delivers Wacom’s most accurate and advanced pen performance and realistic pen-on-paper feel.

Battery free EMR technology, 8,192 levels of pressure sensitivity, tilt-response and virtually lag-free tracking

Wacom Pro Pen 2 is designed for improved accuracy, control and sensitivity

The Pro Pen 2 tip sensor constantly reacts to the changing force of your hand. It has been optimized to respond to 8,192 different pressure levels, which means a lower starting pressure for feather light sensitivity, and a higher maximum pressure for those with a heavier hand.

Ergonomically designed and comfortable for long hours of use

The Pro Pen 2 not only looks like a pen, but it feels like a pen too. From the nib firmness, to the flared grip and side switches within easy reach. Lightweight, with no battery holding you back, it feels comfortable in your hand for hours.

Compatible with

  • Wacom Intuos Pro (PTH660, PTH660P, PTH860, PTH860P, PTH460)
  • Wacom Cintiq Pro 13&16 (DTH1320, DTH1620)
  • Wacom Cintiq Pro 24 (DTK2420, DTH2420)
  • Wacom Cintiq Pro 32 (DTH3220)
  • Wacom MobileStudio Pro (DTHW1320, DTHW1620, DTHW1621H)
  • Wacom Cintiq 16 (DTK-1660)
  • Wacom Cintiq 22 (DTK-2260)
  • DTK-1660E Interactive Pen Display for Business
  • Wacom Intuos Pro (2025) - (PTK470, PTK670, PTK870)
